content:
**brain:ui shows in-flight SDD documents from the local worktree where the work happens (#883)**

What: the snapshot gains a localWorktrees section (one git worktree list, filtered to OPEN issues; the served root is excluded) and the drawer gains an 'on this machine' block per worktree, read-only: up to 3 worktrees per issue, one ls-tree <worktree HEAD sha> on the served root's git (no -C/--git-dir/--work-tree), files hashed as git blobs and marked uncommitted: new, uncommitted: modified, committed on <branch>, not on main, or collapsed as same as main; the block renders before the tabs when main has no change dir; the watcher holds two dir watches per open-issue worktree so an edit reaches the page within one tick; a map card whose change lives only in a worktree says so. Why: the maintainer could see no SDD document of in-flight work, because those live in worktrees (often uncommitted), never on main; only memory legitimately lives uncommitted in main. Learned: filter worktrees by open issue, not by not-merged (squash merges leave no ancestry: 60/62 looked unmerged); a plain read of a FIFO hangs, so lstat first; smoke the overlay by serving the main checkout with --root from the feature worktree; resolve an issue with several matching branches by the worktree that holds its change dir.
source: engram save on gandalf-ROG-Zephyrus-G15-GA503QR-GA503QR; actor from git config brain.actor; actorKind agent from env AI_AGENT=claude-code_2-1-285_agent; issue 883 declared via --issue
